run_gpt4_baseline: run the GPT-4 baseline on an Open-EQA dataset using the CLI with --dataset and --model flags
ask_question_with_gpt4: call ask_question to send a single question to GPT-4 and get a parsed answer string
parse_gpt4_output: use parse_output to extract the answer from a GPT-4 response string after the A: prefix
run_dry_run_gpt4: run the GPT-4 baseline in dry-run mode to process only the first 5 questions
resume_gpt4_results: resume the GPT-4 baseline from a partial results JSON file by pointing --output-directory to existing results
